decision: Both yaw wrap source forms rejected as neutral; source restored
primary_basis: ca1f6 RSB32 target; ca210 SUBS yaw-target; ca214/ca216 MI conditional NEG; ca218 signed target/yaw compare; ca21e target-yaw and ca50c conversion.
trial_A: Only yawDistance subtraction and conditional negation use uint32 modular arithmetic with int32 conversion.
trial_B: Additionally wrap 0x8000-stationAngle and both yawStep subtractions. Other pitch/float arithmetic untouched.
behavior_limit: Unsigned-to-int32 conversion is implementation-defined in C++14; intended ARM/UCRT two-complement targets support it. This does not prove float-to-int, pitch, dt overflow or whole-function runtime safety. For yaw[-65535,65535], stationAngle[0,65535], target[-32767,32768], distance[-98303,98302], old signed arithmetic already fits. No normal-range gameplay fix is claimed.
native_full: Accepted96 native/full remains canonical; identical restored source/object/report, no redundant rerun. Native runtime remains untested.
